provenance.infl: Official statistics: BLS Consumer Price Index (Dec/Dec) via FRED
provenance.g_cup: Official statistics: FHFA all-transactions house-price index, San Jose metro (Q4/Q4) via FRED
provenance.g_sf: Official statistics: FHFA all-transactions house-price index, San Francisco metro (Q4/Q4) via FRED
provenance.g_ca: Official statistics: FHFA all-transactions house-price index, California via FRED
provenance.r_stock: ACADEMIC dataset (NYU Stern / Damodaran) - NOT a government statistic and not officially verified
provenance.r_bond: ACADEMIC dataset (NYU Stern / Damodaran) - NOT a government statistic and not officially verified
provenance.r_bill: ACADEMIC dataset (NYU Stern / Damodaran) - NOT a government statistic and not officially verified
provenance.nat_re_early: ACADEMIC dataset (Damodaran national real-estate returns, 1929-1950) - no official local index exists that far back
provenance.japan: Official series via FRED: BIS residential property prices, OECD CPI; Nikkei 225 PRICE index (dividends excluded)
provenance.prop13_factor: Statutory index: California CPI capped at 2% (R&TC 51). Replayed years 1976-2025 use the official BOE factor table (LTA 2026/002 enclosure; cross-checked against LTA 2020/067 and 2021/065). Future California CPI is unknowable, so baseline years after 2026 and the Japan/Depression counterfactuals use each path's inflation as a LABELLED PROXY (flag A11). Official BOE factor for 2026: 1.02.
provenance.paths: The fifty replays and every named path are HYPOTHETICAL constructions from the series above: illustrative stress tests, not forecasts.
provenance.bootstrap: HYPOTHETICAL construction, drawn by computer: 400 fifty-year paths made of eight-year blocks sampled from the same official 1976-2025 record, with a fixed seed so the run repeats exactly. It shows the spread the historical record supports; it is not a forecast and not a probability of anything.
provenance.estate_alt: Counterfactual built on one official published figure (the $5,490,000 basic exclusion for 2017 on the IRS estate-tax page) indexed forward by the model's own inflation path. Not a proposal, not a forecast, not a pending bill.
provenance.ins_scaled: Derived from two official statewide averages on the Department of Insurance page (average Coverage A and average earned premium per policy). The building share it is applied to is an assumption, so the result is a sensitivity, not a quote.
